name: Reconciliation Type 1 Code
definition: Type of Reconciliation requested by the Sale to the POI.

AREC.name: Acquirer Reconciliation
AREC.definition: Reconciliation between the POI and one or several Acquirers only. There is no reconciliation between the Sale System and the POI System.

ASYN.name: Acquirer Synchronisation
ASYN.definition: Reconciliation and closure of the current period, with synchronisation of the reconciliation between the POI and Acquirers.

PREC.name: Previous Reconciliation
PREC.definition: Request result of a previous reconciliation.

SREC.name: Sale Reconciliation
SREC.definition: Reconciliation with closure of the current period, without any Acquirers synchronisation.
